text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*... *wheeze*...
Grass... what's my... time...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...! Splendid.
You beat your personal best, El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Haaah... haha... I did it!
El has become... even stronger...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Phaaah...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You should lie down too, Grass~...
The breeze feels so nice, desu~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm glad to see you're well.
Would you like some water?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. No problem, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Grass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Please allow me to repay the favor next time.
As a token of appreciation for all your help."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...What's gotten into you? That's not like you at all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fufun. Sounds great, *desu ka*.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El wants to give back!
To Papa, Mama, Grass, and Spe-chan!
To everyone who believed in El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The joy of being number one in the world...
...El wants to deliver it together with her friends!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—It would have been sooo great
if that player were El, though.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if this is only my personal best,
then I'm nowhere near ready. ...The world is still far away.”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then the Umamusume closest to conquering the world right now is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me!!

The door to the trainer's office bursts open.
Standing there is none other than El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have a match!
Between me and all of you!!"
choice_data_list: Compete... You mean a mock race, right now?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No. Let's make it lavish!
Right where everyone's eyes can see!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will definitely defeat you all in the next Representative Match.
You better make sure you're in the same group as El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I must take first place in this year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe no matter what, yes! That is whyâ

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Please brace yourself.
For the Representative Exchange Race.
